about: Surrogate bids (a buyer entering a bid for a vendor from the buyer console). Written 27 Oct 2026 for Aanya: 'next is surrogate bid, work on that. make testcases and test them and generate a table'. Each case has an expected kind (complete: it must work; app_refuses: Procol must refuse it) and the facts Procol's database must hold afterwards (bids are bid_trades → bids). 'to confirm' marks an expectation nobody has checked against Procol's own rules yet. Status: draft until Aanya approves the expectations.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with 1 line item, invite 1 vendor, publish it and place a surrogate bid of 100 for that vendor.
cases.note: the basic surrogate bid, with a price
cases.must: Published RFQ, 1 vendor invited, 1 surrogate bid from that vendor at 100.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with 2 line items, invite 2 vendors, publish it, place a surrogate bid for each vendor and check both vendors show on Master QCS.
cases.note: one bid per vendor, compared (stress B24)
cases.must: 2 vendors invited, a surrogate bid from each (2 bidding vendors), both columns on Master QCS.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, invite the vendor "QA_Platform Vendor 1" by name, publish it and place a surrogate bid for that vendor.
cases.must: "QA_Platform Vendor 1" invited by name and a surrogate bid placed for it.

cases.prompt: On a live RFQ that is open for quotes, place a surrogate bid for an invited vendor who has not bid yet, then check that vendor's row on Participants no longer offers Add Bid.
cases.note: an existing event the run picks from the Live list (vetted in the database)
cases.must: A surrogate bid saved for the picked vendor on the picked event; Add Bid gone for that vendor.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with 1 line item, invite 1 vendor, publish it, place a surrogate bid of 250 for that vendor and check Master QCS shows 250 as that vendor's RFQ rate.
cases.must: Bid at 250, and Master QCS's RFQ Rate for the vendor reads 250.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ event from an existing PR, invite 1 vendor, publish it and place a surrogate bid for that vendor.
cases.note: an event made from a PR (today's PR start)
cases.must: An RFQ made from a PR, published, with 1 surrogate bid.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, invite 1 vendor, publish it, place a surrogate bid for that vendor, then try to place a second surrogate bid for the same vendor.
cases.note: Add Bid is gone after a bid (stress B25)
cases.must: The second surrogate bid is not possible: the vendor's row no longer offers Add Bid; still 1 bidding vendor.

cases.prompt: Create a technical-only event, invite a vendor, publish it and place a surrogate technical response for that vendor from Participants (Add Bid).
cases.note: Procol DOES offer Add Bid on a technical stage — it opens the vendor's technical response (seen 27 Oct; the first expectation, 'no Add Bid', was wrong)
cases.must: On the technical stage, Add Bid opens the vendor's technical response and the buyer submits it for the vendor.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with 1 line item, invite 1 vendor, publish it, open that vendor's Add Bid and submit it without entering a price.
cases.note: to confirm: Procol should refuse a bid with no price
cases.must: Procol refuses the empty bid (an error naming the price); no bid saved.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with 1 line item, invite 1 vendor, publish it and try to place a surrogate bid of -50 for that vendor.
cases.note: to confirm: a negative price should be refused
cases.must: Procol refuses a negative price; no bid at -50 saved.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, invite 1 vendor, publish it, place a surrogate bid for that vendor and check that Counter Offer for that vendor is disabled on Master QCS.
cases.note: Counter Offer is greyed out on a surrogate bid (stress B33, which tried to send one)
cases.must: Counter Offer is shown greyed out for the vendor's surrogate bid; 1 bid.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with 1 line item, invite 1 vendor, publish it, place a surrogate bid for that vendor, end the bidding, then check that no vendor offers Add Bid on Participants.
cases.note: no surrogate bid once bidding is over — on the run's own event (the first version picked another team's event and got one still open)
cases.must: After the bidding ends, Participants show no Add Bid; 1 bid.

cases.prompt: Create an auction with one item, invite a vendor, publish it and place a surrogate bid of 100 for that vendor. Then check the buyer cannot revise it: the vendor's Participants row no longer offers Add Bid, and the bid stays at 100.
cases.note: a surrogate bid on an auction cannot be revised by the buyer (Aanya, 28 Oct: no revision possible)
cases.must: Auction, 1 vendor, a surrogate bid of 100; afterwards no Add Bid for that vendor, and the bid stays 100.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with 1 line item, invite 2 vendors, publish it, place a surrogate bid of 100 for one vendor and 120 for the other, then check Master QCS ranks the 100 bid first.
cases.must: Two bids (100 and 120) from two vendors; Rank 1 is the 100 bid.
